answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in vine, expire in oasis, and thread lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 143 aliases therefore needs 171 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 859 identities would post 1937 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
